guide.goal: 教育部國小英語文學習成就評量標準：自然拼讀 (Phonics)、簡易日常生活對話與作息表達。
guide.motivation: 早晨 7:00 鬧鐘響起，國小生如何在真實世界用英語安排自己的作息？英美人士在日常生活中更習慣說 'half past seven' 或 'a quarter to eight'，學會鐘點表達法與時間介系詞，就能精確掌控生活節奏。

tips.title: 英美時鐘視覺化報時法 (Clock Division Rule)
tips.formula: 1-30分用 PAST (過幾分)；31-59分用 TO (差幾分到整點)
tips.body: 以 30 分鐘為分水嶺：整點用 o'clock；15分用 a quarter past；30分用 half past；45分用 a quarter to。
tips.example: 8:15 = a quarter past eight / 8:45 = a quarter to nine / 8:30 = half past eight

tips.title: 時間介系詞「倒金字塔法則」 (at, on, in)
tips.formula: at (特定時刻/點) ➔ on (特定日期/星期/面) ➔ in (月份/年份/季節/長時段)
tips.body: 最精確的時間點用 at (at 7:30, at noon)；特定日子用 on (on Monday, on my birthday)；廣泛長時間用 in (in May, in 2026, in summer)。
tips.example: We meet at 6:30 on Friday evening in autumn.

tips.title: 6 大頻率副詞與「Be後動前」黃金定律
tips.formula: always（總是）／usually（通常）／often（經常）／sometimes（有時）／seldom（很少）／never（從不）；中間頻率沒有固定百分比
tips.body: 位置法則：放在 be 動詞或助動詞之後，一般動詞之前。never 與 seldom 本身帶有否定含意，不需再加 not。
tips.example: He is always punctual. / She never skips breakfast.

traps.wrong: It is a quarter to eight at 8:15.
traps.correct: It is a quarter past eight.
traps.reason: past 是過了幾分，to 是差幾分。8:15 是過了 8 點 15 分，應用 past。

traps.wrong: I go always to bed at 10.
traps.correct: I always go to bed at 10.
traps.reason: 頻率副詞口訣「Be後動前」，go 是一般動詞，副詞放前面。
never 本身帶有否定意義，絕對不能跟 doesn't 連用形成雙重否定。

dialogue.speaker: Liam
dialogue.en: Good morning, Emma! What time do you usually wake up on weekdays?
dialogue.zh: 早安，Emma！妳平日通常幾點起床？

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: I always get up at half past six. Then I take a quick shower.
dialogue.zh: 我總是在六點半起床，然後沖個澡。

dialogue.speaker: Liam
dialogue.en: Wow, that is early! I usually wake up at a quarter to seven.
dialogue.zh: 哇，好早喔！我通常差一刻七點（6:45）才起來。

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: Don't be late for school! Assembly starts at eight o'clock sharp.
dialogue.zh: 上學別遲到囉！朝會八點整準時開始。

checklist: 我能用 half past、quarter past 與 quarter to 精確報時
我能分清 at（鐘點）、on（日期/星期）、in（年月/長時段）的差別
我能正確將 6 大頻率副詞放置在「Be動詞後、一般動詞前」
我知道 never 和 seldom 句子中不可再加 not
我能用 What time do you...? 進行完整的日常生活問答

guide.goal: 教育部國小英語文學習成就評量標準：自然拼讀 (Phonics)、簡易日常生活對話與作息表達。
guide.motivation: 週末去了花蓮太魯閣、暑假跟家人露營，要如何用英文跟外國朋友生動分享過去的精采回憶？過去簡單式是英文敘事最核心的時態基石。

tips.title: 規則動詞字尾 +ed 發音三大法則
tips.formula: 1. /t/ (清子音後) 2. /d/ (濁子音與母音後) 3. /ɪd/ (字尾為 /t/ 或 /d/ 後)
tips.body: looked /t/, helped /t/; played /d/, cleaned /d/; wanted /ɪd/, needed /ɪd/。注意發音切勿死背，要感受聲帶是否振動。
tips.example: He jumped /t/ into the pool and floated /ɪd/ on the water.

tips.title: 高頻不規則動詞三態變化歸類
tips.body: 大考常考不規則變化：eat-ate, see-saw, write-wrote, take-took, give-gave, swim-swam。
tips.example: Yesterday Leo bought a ticket and went to the zoo alone.

tips.title: 過去式否定句與疑問句之「助動詞魔法」
tips.formula: Did + 主詞 + 原形動詞...? / 主詞 + didn't + 原形動詞
tips.body: 助動詞 did 已經吸走了過去時態，後面主要動詞務必立刻恢復「原形」！
tips.example: Did you see the movie? Yes, I saw it. / No, I didn't see it.

traps.wrong: Did you went to school yesterday?
traps.correct: Did you go to school yesterday?
traps.reason: Did 已經是過去式助動詞，後面動詞必須恢復原形 go。

traps.wrong: My uncle buyed a new car last month.
traps.correct: My uncle bought a new car last month.
traps.reason: buy 是不規則變化動詞，過去式為 bought。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Hey Mia, how was your weekend trip to Kenting?
dialogue.zh: 嘿 Mia，妳週末去墾丁玩得如何？

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: It was fantastic! We swam in the ocean and built sandcastles.
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！我們在海裡游泳還堆了沙堡。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Did you see any sea turtles while snorkeling?
dialogue.zh: 浮潛時有看到海龜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Yes, we did! We took dozens of amazing underwater photos.
dialogue.zh: 有啊！我們拍了幾十張驚豔的海底照片。

checklist: 我能熟記 30 個最常考的不規則動詞三態變化
我能分清 -ed 發音的清濁音差別 (/t/, /d/, /ɪd/)
我牢記在 Did 與 didn't 後面必須使用動詞原形
我能用過去式流暢寫出三句描述昨天的生活日記
guide.level: A1 ~ Pre-A2 (基礎起步 · 雙語銜接)

extra.title: 現在簡單式與過去簡單式
extra.rule: 現在簡單式描述習慣、一般事實；過去簡單式把事件放在已結束的過去。時間線索必須配合語意判斷。

rows: She checks the lights every day.

extra.trap: did 後用原形，不能寫 Did she checked? 不規則過去式要另記，如 go → went。

guide.goal: 教育部國小英語文學習成就評量標準：自然拼讀 (Phonics)、簡易日常生活對話與作息表達。
guide.motivation: 在台北街頭遇到外國遊客問路：'Excuse me, how can I get to the MRT station?'，你能立刻用流利英語為他指點迷津嗎？問路與指路是真實生活不可或缺的交際素養。

tips.title: 公共設施與市容場所核心詞庫
tips.formula: bakery, post office, convenience store, pharmacy, museum, fire station
tips.body: 複合名詞重音多在第一部分 (BUS stop, FIRE station, POST office)。
tips.example: The library is across from the post office on Zhongshan Road.

tips.title: 空間方位介系詞黃金搭配
tips.formula: next to (旁邊) / across from (對面) / between A and B (在兩者之間) / on the corner of (轉角)
tips.body: between A and B 可表兩個地標之間；between 也可用於多個分別明確的對象，並非只能接兩者。
tips.example: The bakery is on the corner of Main Street and Park Road.

tips.title: 禮貌問路與指路萬能句型
tips.formula: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to...? / Go straight for two blocks, then turn right.
tips.body: 指路動詞：go straight (直走), turn left/right (左/右轉), cross the street (過馬路), walk past (經過)。
tips.example: Go straight along this street, and you will see the station on your left.

traps.wrong: The bank is between the clinic.
traps.correct: The bank is between the clinic and the post office.
traps.reason: between 後面必須有兩者，若只有一個地點應使用 next to 或 across from。

traps.wrong: Turn to right at the corner.
traps.reason: turn 這裡當方向動詞，後面直接加副詞 right，不可加介系詞 to。

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: Excuse me, sir. Could you tell me where the nearest metro station is?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，先生。能請問最近的捷運站在哪裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Sure! Go straight for two blocks and turn left at the bakery.
dialogue.zh: 當然！直走兩個街區，然後在麵包店左轉。

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: Is it far from here? Can I walk there?
dialogue.zh: 離這裡很遠嗎？我走路到得了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: It's very close. It takes only five minutes on foot. It's on your right.
dialogue.zh: 非常近，走路只要五分鐘。就在您的右手邊。

checklist: 我能說出 10 個常見城市場所與設施的英文名稱
我能熟練運用 across from, next to, between A and B 描述地圖位置
我能聽懂並給出 go straight, turn left, turn right 指路指令
我能禮貌使用 Excuse me... 展開生活問路會話
guide.level: A1 ~ Pre-A2 (基礎起步 · 雙語銜接)

extra.title: 聽不懂怎麼辦：請求重述、確認與國際禮儀
extra.rule: 聽不懂不是失敗，而是需要「溝通策略」。①請求重述：Sorry? / Could you say that again, please? ②請放慢：Could you speak more slowly? ③確認理解：Do you mean…? / So you’re saying… ④問字義：What does “…” mean? 也可以用手勢、指物、畫圖幫忙。國際禮儀方面：交談時看著對方、等對方說完再回答、說 please / thank you / excuse me，排隊時保持距離，不隨意詢問年齡、體重或收入等私人問題。
pairs: Sorry, could you say that again, please?
Do you mean the bus stop near the park?
用 Do you mean… 確認理解。
Excuse me, may I ask a question?
打斷別人前先說 Excuse me。
extra.trap: 常見錯誤：聽不懂就一直點頭說 Yes，結果答非所問；或直接說 What?（語氣生硬）。改用 Sorry? 或 Could you say that again, please?。另外，初次見面問 How old are you? 或 How much do you earn? 在很多文化中不禮貌。
extra.model: Tourist: Where is the Taipei Story House? / Me: Sorry, could you say that again, please? / Tourist: The Taipei Story House. / Me: Oh, do you mean the old house near the Fine Arts Museum? It’s a ten-minute walk. 檢查：有沒有用到請求重述或確認的句型？

guide.goal: 教育部國小英語文學習成就評量標準：自然拼讀 (Phonics)、簡易日常生活對話與作息表達。
guide.motivation: 生病感冒去看醫生，如何用英語清楚向醫師表達自己的症狀？出國旅遊遇到胃痛發燒，懂得準確的醫療英文是自保求助的關鍵素養。

tips.title: -ache 身體疼痛複合字與疾病冠詞規則
tips.formula: head + ache = headache / tooth + ache = toothache / stomach + ache = stomachache
tips.body: 表達病症通常用 have a ...：have a cold, have a fever, have a sore throat, have a headache。
tips.example: He has a terrible stomachache because he ate expired seafood.

tips.title: 看病醫病問答核心句型
tips.formula: Doctor: What's wrong? / What's the matter? ➔ Patient: I have a... / My [body part] hurts.
tips.body: 注意 hurt 作為動詞時，主詞為第三人稱單數要加 -s (My leg hurts)。
tips.example: What's the matter with you? I have a bad cough and my chest hurts.

tips.title: 醫師衛教建議句型 should / shouldn't
tips.formula: You should + 原形動詞 / You shouldn't + 原形動詞
tips.body: 情態助動詞 should 表「應該」，後方動詞絕對不能加 to 或 -ing。
tips.example: You should drink plenty of warm water and stay in bed.

traps.wrong: You should to take this medicine.
traps.reason: should 是情態助動詞，後面直接加原形動詞，不可加 to。
大部分身體小毛病如 cold, fever, headache 前面需要不定冠詞 a。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I don't feel well. My throat hurts.
dialogue.zh: 我不舒服，喉嚨痛。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Have you told the school nurse?
dialogue.zh: 聽起來真不好受。你告訴校護了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Not yet. Could you walk there with me?
dialogue.zh: 還沒。你可以陪我走過去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Of course. Let's ask the nurse what to do next.
dialogue.zh: 當然。我們問問校護接下來怎麼辦。

checklist: 我能正確拼寫並朗讀 headache, toothache, stomachache
我能聽懂醫師問句 What's the matter? 並清楚回答
我能用 should / shouldn't 給予同儕健康生活建議
我知道 should 後面必須接動詞原形

guide.goal: 教育部國小英語文學習成就評量標準：自然拼讀 (Phonics)、簡易日常生活對話與作息表達。
guide.motivation: 臺灣有農曆新年與中秋節，英美有萬聖節與聖誕節。跨文化溝通不僅是背單字，更是學會尊重並生動介紹彼此的文化傳統。

tips.title: 東西方重要節慶英譯與飲食詞彙
tips.formula: Lunar New Year (dumplings), Dragon Boat Festival (rice dumplings), Moon Festival (mooncakes), Halloween (costumes), Christmas (turkey)
tips.body: 專有名詞節慶首字母必須大寫。
tips.example: Families gather together to eat reunion dinner on Lunar New Year's Eve.

tips.title: 節慶日期與季節介系詞用法
tips.formula: on + 特定節慶日子 (on Christmas Day, on Halloween) / in + 季節/月份 (in winter, in December)
tips.body: 如果是節慶假期的總稱，英式英語也常說 at Christmas。特定某一天一律用 on。

traps.reason: Halloween 是特定節日日子，介系詞用 on。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Do you celebrate Thanksgiving with your family?
dialogue.zh: 你和家人會過感恩節嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes. We usually have dinner together. What about your family?
dialogue.zh: 會。我們通常一起吃晚餐。你們家呢？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: We celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival. We eat mooncakes.
dialogue.zh: 我們過中秋節，會吃月餅。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: That sounds fun. I'd love to try one.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很好玩。我很想試吃一個。

checklist: 我能用英語說出臺灣三大傳統節日與西方兩大節日名稱
我能熟練運用 on 搭配特定節日、in 搭配月份季節
guide.level: A1 ~ Pre-A2 (基礎起步 · 雙語銜接)

extra.title: 用英語介紹臺灣節慶，比較國外習俗
extra.rule: 介紹節慶可以用「時間＋活動＋食物＋意義」四個部分：The Dragon Boat Festival is in May or June. People race dragon boats and eat rice dumplings. It remembers the poet Qu Yuan. 比較文化時用 both…and…、while、however 說出異同，並避免用「奇怪」「落後」評價別人的習俗，改用 different、interesting、special。每個國家的節日都有它的歷史與意義，了解原因比記住名稱更重要。
pairs: People give red envelopes during Chinese New Year.
說明習俗：誰＋做什麼＋何時。
Both Mid-Autumn Festival and Thanksgiving are about family and harvest.
用 both…and… 說出相同點。
In Taiwan we bow slightly, while many Americans shake hands.
用 while 比較差異，不加評價。
extra.trap: 常見錯誤：說 Their festival is strange.（帶有評價）→ 改說 Their festival is different from ours. 另外，節日名稱要大寫：Christmas、Lantern Festival。
extra.model: The Lantern Festival is on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month. People carry lanterns and guess riddles. Many families eat sweet rice balls. It marks the end of the New Year celebrations. Like Halloween, children enjoy colorful lights, but the Lantern Festival is about family reunion. 檢查：有時間、活動、食物、意義和比較嗎？

guide.motivation: 小升初的關鍵轉折就是閱讀長度增加！學會掌握字首字尾快速推測單字意思，學會略讀與掃讀，就能在 10 分鐘內讀懂長篇故事與科普短文。

tips.title: 三大高頻字尾詞性轉換魔法
tips.example: The architect planned the project carefully to avoid environmental pollution.

traps.wrong: 遇到不懂的字立刻停下來查字典。
traps.correct: 利用前後句子語意猜測詞意，先完成整篇閱讀。
traps.reason: 考場沒有字典，108 課綱評量的是脈絡理解與推論能力。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: This story says the island was unknown. What does unknown mean?
dialogue.zh: 故事說這座島是 unknown。Unknown 是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Known means people know it. Un- makes it the opposite.
dialogue.zh: Known 表示人們知道，un- 讓意思相反。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: So nobody knew about the island yet?
dialogue.zh: 所以當時還沒有人知道這座島？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Right. Let's read the next sentence to check.
dialogue.zh: 對。我們讀下一句確認一下。

checklist: 我能辨認 -tion, -ful, -ly 等常見字尾並判定詞性
我能靈活運用 Skimming 略讀與 Scanning 掃讀兩種大考策略

guide.goal: 教育部國小英語文學習成就評量標準：自然拼讀 (Phonics)、簡易日常生活對話與作息表達。
guide.motivation: 國小畢業即將邁入國中，你對未來的自己有什麼期許？想當建築師、軟體工程師、還是太空人？用未來式句型堅定宣告自己的夢想！

tips.title: will 與 be going to 的精妙語意區別
tips.formula: will + 原形動詞 (即時決定、客觀預測) vs be going to + 原形動詞 (事先規劃、強烈跡象)
tips.body: 看天色烏雲密布有明顯跡象用 Look! It is going to rain. 即時幫忙用 I will help you.
tips.example: I am going to study architecture in the future. / Don't worry, I will support you.

traps.wrong: I will going to study abroad.
traps.correct: I will study abroad. / I am going to study abroad.
traps.reason: will 和 be going to 是兩種不同的未來式結構，不可混雜在一起。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: What are you going to do this summer?
dialogue.zh: 今年暑假你打算做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: I'm going to help at an animal shelter.
dialogue.zh: 我打算去動物收容所幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Really? Do you want to work with animals someday?
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？你以後想從事和動物有關的工作嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes. I want to be a vet when I grow up.
dialogue.zh: 想。我長大想當獸醫。

checklist: 我能分清 will (即時決定) 與 be going to (事先規劃) 的細微差別
我能在 will / be going to 後面正確使用動詞原形
guide.level: A1 ~ Pre-A2 (基礎起步 · 雙語銜接)

extra.title: 未來表達：will、going to 與安排
extra.rule: 英文可用多種形式談未來。依當下決定、事先計畫、已安排活動或時刻表選擇。

rows: We are going to test the robot.
We are meeting the engineer tomorrow.
表定未來也可用現在簡單式。

g6-s1-u1.tip1.title: 英美時鐘視覺化報時法 (Clock Division Rule)
g6-s1-u1.tip1.formula: 1-30分用 PAST (過幾分)；31-59分用 TO (差幾分到整點)
g6-s1-u1.tip1.body: 以 30 分鐘為分水嶺：整點用 o'clock；15分用 a quarter past；30分用 half past；45分用 a quarter to。
g6-s1-u1.tip1.example: 8:15 = a quarter past eight / 8:45 = a quarter to nine / 8:30 = half past eight

g6-s1-u1.x1.prompt: Look at the departure board at the train station. The express train to Kaohsiung departs at 8:45. Which of the following is the correct announcement?

options: The train departs at a quarter to nine.
The train departs at a quarter past eight.
The train departs at half past eight.
The train departs at a quarter to eight.
g6-s1-u1.x1.hint: 1-30分用 PAST (過幾分)；31-59分用 TO (差幾分到整點)
g6-s1-u1.x1.why: 8:45 已經過了 30 分，英文常說「差幾分到下一個整點」：差 15 分到 9 點，所以是 a quarter to nine。a quarter past eight 是 8:15，half past eight 是 8:30，a quarter to eight 是 7:45。

g6-s1-u1.tip2.title: 時間介系詞「倒金字塔法則」 (at, on, in)
g6-s1-u1.tip2.formula: at (特定時刻/點) ➔ on (特定日期/星期/面) ➔ in (月份/年份/季節/長時段)
g6-s1-u1.tip2.body: 最精確的時間點用 at (at 7:30, at noon)；特定日子用 on (on Monday, on my birthday)；廣泛長時間用 in (in May, in 2026, in summer)。
g6-s1-u1.tip2.example: We meet at 6:30 on Friday evening in autumn.

g6-s1-u1.x2.why: 【考點解構】套用倒金字塔法則：特定時間點 9:00 用 at；特定某天的早晨 (Monday morning) 用 on；月份 (early October) 用 in，因此唯一正確搭配為 at; on; in。

g6-s1-u1.tip3.title: 6 大頻率副詞與「Be後動前」黃金定律
g6-s1-u1.tip3.formula: always（總是）／usually（通常）／often（經常）／sometimes（有時）／seldom（很少）／never（從不）；中間頻率沒有固定百分比
g6-s1-u1.tip3.body: 位置法則：放在 be 動詞或助動詞之後，一般動詞之前。never 與 seldom 本身帶有否定含意，不需再加 not。

g6-s1-u2.tip1.formula: 1. /t/ (清子音後) 2. /d/ (濁子音與母音後) 3. /ɪd/ (字尾為 /t/ 或 /d/ 後)

g6-s1-u2.x1.hint: 1. /t/ (清子音後) 2. /d/ (濁子音與母音後) 3. /ɪd/ (字尾為 /t/ 或 /d/ 後)
g6-s1-u2.x1.why: 【考點解構】時間副詞 Yesterday afternoon 明確指示過去時間，前後對等連接詞 and 連接兩個過去簡單式主動動詞：flip -> flipped (重複字尾加 ed)，discover -> discovered。

g6-s1-u2.tip2.title: 高頻不規則動詞三態變化歸類
g6-s1-u2.tip2.body: 大考常考不規則變化：eat-ate, see-saw, write-wrote, take-took, give-gave, swim-swam。
g6-s1-u2.tip2.example: Yesterday Leo bought a ticket and went to the zoo alone.

g6-s1-u2.x2.prompt: Last Sunday, we ___ to the zoo and ___ many animals.
g6-s1-u2.x2.why: 【考點解構】Last Sunday 是過去時間。go 和 see 都是不規則動詞：go → went，see → saw；seen 是過去分詞，不能單獨當過去式；goed、seed 都是錯誤拼法。

g6-s1-u2.tip3.title: 過去式否定句與疑問句之「助動詞魔法」
g6-s1-u2.tip3.formula: Did + 主詞 + 原形動詞...? / 主詞 + didn't + 原形動詞
g6-s1-u2.tip3.body: 助動詞 did 已經吸走了過去時態，後面主要動詞務必立刻恢復「原形」！
g6-s1-u2.tip3.example: Did you see the movie? Yes, I saw it. / No, I didn't see it.
